title: Malicious code in wanzy (npm)
description: The npm package 'wanzy' contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise includes potential unauthorized access to all secrets and keys stored on the affected system. Immediate removal of the package is recommended, but full remediation may require rotating all secrets and keys from a separate, uncompromised device due to the risk of persistent malicious software.
